strings: r_c0 sits with m_c, trading signs back and forth when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/stop/stops} speaking.
Nobody minds when m_c has a few bad days and chooses to just use sign to communicate rather than trying to strain to speak.
Frustrated at not been able to tell if {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} speaking clearly, m_c just decides to use {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} best communication method instead.
